filed: 2026-11-23, definition-lead (writer agent), before any GPU run of this experiment

settings.lr_source: Liu et al. 2022 (arXiv 2205.05638) section 3.5: the T-Few recipe trains (IA)3 with 'a learning rate of 3e-3'; appendix D gives full fine-tuning 3e-4 in the same setting, so IA3's rate is 10x full fine-tuning's there; the optimizer is ours (next key)
settings.optimizer_source: E147's full fine-tunes (commute.finetune._run: Adam, betas 0.9/0.999, no weight decay, no warm-up), kept so the two arms differ only in which parameters train and the rate; the paper uses Adafactor with a 60-step warm-up and linear decay over 1,000 steps (a departure, listed in the plan)
settings.recipe_source: batch, grad_clip, kl_lambda, sampler seed = the task seed, the loss (commute.finetune.arm_a_loss: CE on the table target at the half position plus KL to M elsewhere) and the windows file per map: E147's (keydep.finetune through finetune.ArmAConfig defaults; windows from experiments/refit_96key/results/inventory.json). checkpoints and p_learn: E12's rule (keydep.E12_CHECKS, keydep.scored_step: the first of 10, 30, 100, 300 with held-out P(target) >= 0.5, else 300). full_step: the step E147 saved and E237/E278 read
settings.scan_source: band and the neuron scan: E277's filed settings (experiments/needed_neurons/results/predictions.json); the VPD scan: E268's filed settings through experiments/kstar_needed/run.py load_config, as E278 read them
settings.built_gain_source: the stage-0 built edit l = 1 + 0.003 z (z standard normal, one per neuron of every down_proj): 0.003 is one Adam step at lr, the smallest per-step move, so the rounding floor it measures is at least as large as a trained arm's (the floor scales as 1 / (l - 1)^2)
settings.floor_source: floor_factor: E229's filed factor on a measured floor. floor_min: E277's measured neurons-only 1 - E_b on its built x10 edit (4.4e-16, experiments/needed_neurons/results/summary.json items.x10.E_b_K_neurons) rounded up to 1e-12, used only if the stage-0 floor reads exactly 0. floor_stop: a sanity stop on stage 0's built edit, from arithmetic, not a measurement: fp32 rounding of l W gives a relative error near 6e-8 / |l - 1| in the write change, about 4e-10 in 1 - E_b at |l - 1| = 0.003; 1e-6 is over 1000x that
settings.random_max_source: E278's filed random_max; measured randoms at neurons read E_b over K 0.003-0.013 (E277, 20 items)

items.trainer: commute.gains (E231's gain-only trainer: down_proj-input gains, ones at init, Adam on the gains only, the caller's sampler and loss), extended with output gains on k_proj and v_proj for the ia3 arm and without E231's o_proj head gains; the gains are folded into fp32 weights for reading (E231's bf16 export would add a rounding of (l - 1) near 2^-9 relative, about 1e-6 in 1 - E_b_K_neurons, at the size of the effect R1 guards)
items.train: per arm, task and seed: the gains trained from ones with the recipe above, saved at every checkpoint as fp32 vectors (results/large/gains_<arm>_<task>_s<seed>.pt, 74 KB); held-out P(target) at each checkpoint and the read step by E12's rule
items.read: every gain state folded into M's weights (k_proj and v_proj rows times l, down_proj columns times l; dW = W times (l - 1)) at its read step, on the D E237's World gives the same state (512 windows, last position)
items.full: E147's saved step-30 update of the same task and seed (experiments/refit_96key/results/large/dW_<map>_s<seed>.pt), read on the same D: the reference
items.random: beside every read item, a Gaussian per changed tensor at that item's Frobenius norm of F - M (E277's matched_random), seed random_seed + item index
items.neurons: all 15 states x (ffn, ia3, full) and each one's random: 90 items
items.vpd: seed 0 only, descriptive: ffn, ia3 and full for the five tasks, each with its random: 30 items; full copy_s0 at c = 1 is E275's prior read (experiments/kstar_needed/results/items/e58-copy_s0_scaled.json), taken from there

readings.E_b_K: commute.stand_in.explained_share(num, den, dd, K and changed), K by the featurization's single-variable interchange (E277's needed_neurons.scan at neurons, E268's needed.needed_set at VPD), as filed: remainders in
readings.E_b_K_neurons: the same over K and changed and the neuron variables only (E277's column)
readings.E_b_K_no_rem: the same over K and changed without the remainders (heads and neurons; E277's column)
readings.rem_dd_share: the remainders' share of dd over K and changed (E277's column)
readings.gain_share: (p_arm - p0) / (p_full - p0), p held-out P(target) by commute.finetune.eval_arm_a on the map's held-out windows, p0 at M, p_arm at the arm's read step, p_full on M + E147's saved step-30 update; also at step 30

rules.R0a: Stage 0 of each featurization stops the job on any argmax change under the identity interchange (x' = x) on the control item (the built gain edit of R0d at neurons, its first 64 windows and every variable; E278's control at VPD); its largest logit deviation is recorded
rules.R0b: Stage 0 stops the job unless the do-nothing (F = M) has no changed variable, dd max exactly 0.0 and E_b over K exactly 1.0
rules.R0c: The trainer at initialisation (every gain 1.0, step 0) folds to a dW that is exactly 0.0 in every tensor, and its held-out P(target) equals M's exactly (Liu et al.: 'initialized with ones so that the overall function computed by the model does not change'); a miss stops the job
rules.R0d: Stage 0 at neurons reads the built gain edit (built_gain_sd, built_gain_seed): no head changed, and f0 = 1 - E_b_K_neurons; the job stops if f0 > floor_stop or f0 < 0 by more than 1e-15
rules.R1: The control (both arms, every state): 1 - E_b_K_neurons <= floor_factor x max(f0, floor_min). A state with fewer than too_small needed changed neurons reads 'too small to read' and is not scored. A miss is an apparatus failure: the run stops and the lead reports before anything else is read
rules.R1b: The ffn arm changes no head: n changed heads is exactly 0 in every ffn item (a construction check; a miss stops)
rules.R2: Task gain. Per task, bar = min over seeds of (p_full - p0) / max over seeds of (p_full - p0), from this run's p values. An arm 'reaches the full gain' on a task when its mean gain_share over the three seeds is at least the bar; else it reached that mean share, reported as such. A task where p_full - p0 <= 0 on any seed has no gain to match: 'not read'
rules.R3: The rivals, ffn arm, E_b_K as filed (remainders in), only on tasks where ffn reaches the full gain (R2): rival A when ffn minus full of the same seed is >= rival_gap on all three seeds; rival B when it is < rival_gap on all three; otherwise 'split'. Across tasks: A when every reached task reads A, B when every one reads B, else split. No reached task: 'no call', with the shares reached
rules.R4: Randoms: expected at or under random_max; one above is reported beside its item, not a stop
rules.descriptive: the ia3 arm's E_b_K and E_b_K_no_rem and its heads; rem_dd_share; every VPD reading; the gain at step 30 and at every checkpoint

expected.stage0: identity: 0 argmax changes, largest logit deviation near E277's 8.2e-5 at neurons and E268's 5.1e-5 at VPD; do-nothing: 0 changed, dd max 0.0, E_b over K 1.0; trainer at init: dW 0.0, P(target) equal; built gain edit: no head changed, f0 about 1e-10 (fp32 rounding arithmetic), certainly under 1e-6
expected.train: about 11 s per 300-step run (E147: 1.1 s per 30 steps), 30 runs in about 6 min. Held-out P(target) at step 30: full 0.67-0.81 (cipher) and 0.94-1.00 (the others, E147 stage0.json). Gain arms: most tasks reach the full gain by step 100 or 300 rather than 30; cipher is the redteam's candidate for one that does not, but E231 (neuron and head gains, the same rate, on the built pairs) had its cipher sides reach 0.72-0.91 of their references, so cipher reaching would not surprise. ia3 at or above ffn on every task
expected.neurons: ffn: 1 - E_b_K_neurons under 1e-9 and E_b_K_no_rem the same (no head changes), so R1 passes; E_b_K with the remainders 0.2-0.7, set by the remainders' share of dd times their unexplained part (a remainder is a sum over about 97% of a layer's neurons with gains of both signs about 1, so its own kept share is low; E277's built x2, a uniform gain, had rem_dd_share 0.0002, its trained items 0.62-0.76). ia3: neurons-only 1 as ffn; its heads change (key gains move the attention pattern, value gains turn a head's write inside its own space), so E_b_K_no_rem and E_b_K below ffn's. full: E_b_K 0.017-0.038 as E277's trained items. randoms: 0.003-0.03. |K|: thousands (E277 trained 2,835-7,317 of 12,316). Lean: rival A on the tasks that reach the gain, with the remainder share the number to watch
expected.vpd: descriptive: ffn between full (E275/E278 key grid 0.027-0.040 scaled, copy 0.034 at own size) and 1, since a per-neuron gain on down_proj is a gain per subcomponent only where a subcomponent's input direction sits on few neurons; ia3 below ffn; randoms 0.013-0.017 (E278)
expected.time: neurons about 40-100 s per item (E277's trained items, same D shape), 90 items about 1.5 h; VPD about 300 s per item on an L40 (E278's grid randoms), 29 read items about 2.4 h; 10 cluster debug jobs of under 30 min, $0
